Subject: Promo pool for Nov 30 partner webinar — code batches and allocation

Hi Markus / Camila,

Eventure (partner running the Nov 30 webinar) just confirmed 1,200 expected registrants. They asked if we can provide a promotional pool they can distribute during the session and in follow-up emails — promo codes that grant a 30-day trial with $200 in trial credits (redeemable against hosted API usage).

Proposed allocation (first pass):
- 1,000 single-use codes for webinar registrants (expire 12/31/2025)
- 150 reserve codes for follow-up nurture sequences (sales outreach)
- 50 enterprise warm leads (larger credit; handled by SDRs)

Attached: Webinar_Promo_Pack_v3.pdf (campaign copy + timing) and an initial CSV with code buckets (webinar_promo_codes_202511.csv).

Questions for approval:
1) Is the total pool (1,200) approved?
2) Any limits on code value / per-account redemptions we should enforce?
3) Tracking: we'll use a UTM + HubSpot form mapping; Camila can confirm mapping.

Camila: can you confirm partner-side deliverables (email list, send time, code ingestion method)?

Thanks — hoping to finalize by EOD Monday so Partner Ops can load codes.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Marketing Manager, Demand Gen
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — quick follow-ups before I sign off: 

- I support a promotional pool, but want to limit total monetary exposure. Confirm that each code maxes at $200 and we enforce single-account redemption. (If the code is used by the same billing account twice, it should be blocked.)
- Can we enforce per-account token caps or a simple per-account flag? If not, reduce the credit to $150.
- Tracking: good to see HubSpot mapping. Please include a sample success payload we expect when a code is redeemed (so we can surface conversion in Console).

Dylan (cc): please be ready to take the 50 enterprise warm leads — we should treat those differently (larger credit + SDR concierge).

Assuming safeguards above, approve the 1,000/150/50 split. Partner Ops should coordinate ingestion and expiry dates.

Markus
Markus Klein
